main_text.p: figuram, & ordinem humano corpori conuenientem, (quæ Bellarmini verba sunt) non rationem modo exuperat, sed fidem : Neque iam (vt olim) Ecce hîc Christus, aut illîc, sed (quod longè turpius) Ecce & hic Christus, & illic ; Æternæ veritatis illud est receptissimum in scholis axioma ; Vnitas numerica rei finitæ consistere non potest absque continuitate : Quem non pudeat hîc Iesuitarum ? Loca ipsa in quibus Christi corpus est (inquit Bellarminus) discontinua sunt, sed & Christi corpus diuisum est a se, respectu loci ; sed non respectu propriæ subContr. Vorst. epistrib. epist. e Iul. Scal.

page.notes: Marginal note at right is partly illegible; transcribed as best read. The catchword is partly cut off ("stantiæ," with the first letters of the next word). Margin fragments at the far right edge (faint, show-through from the adjacent page) are omitted.
